customManagers.description: Track a tool version passed to a GitHub Action via a `with: version:` input (e.g. knope-dev/action, golangci-lint-action, mlugg/setup-zig). The github-actions manager pins the action's `uses:` SHA but not the version: input, so the tool version drifts silently. Reads a `# renovate:` annotation on the line directly above `version:`, with an optional per-line extractVersion (knope's release tags are monorepo-prefixed knope/vX.Y.Z). Scoped to the workflows that carry these pins. golangci-lint and setup-zig follow the base auto-merge policy. knope is held by the rule below.

packageRules.description: Hold knope bumps for review. knope is the release tool: it runs only in knope-prepare / knope-release, never on the Renovate PR, so no PR check proves a new knope still cuts a release.
